# Airport Bansko Transfer

> Private, fixed-price airport transfer service between Sofia, Plovdiv (Bulgaria), Thessaloniki and Kavala (Greece) airports and the Bansko area (Bansko, Dobrinishte, Pirin Golf, Razlog) in Bulgaria's Pirin mountains.

Airport Bansko Transfer runs private, door-to-door car transfers — not shared shuttles. Prices are fixed and quoted instantly online before any personal details are collected. No prepayment is required: customers pay the driver on arrival in EUR, USD or GBP, cash or Revolut. Cancellation is free at any time. Drivers track incoming flights and wait at arrivals (meet & greet), including during delays. Vehicles carry up to 8 passengers.

## Key facts
- Service area: transfers to/from Bansko, Dobrinishte, Pirin Golf and Razlog, Bulgaria.
- Airports served: Sofia Airport (Bulgaria), Plovdiv Airport (Bulgaria), Thessaloniki Airport (Greece), Kavala Airport (Greece).
- Pricing: fixed, all-inclusive price shown instantly in the booking form based on route and passenger count; no hidden fees for luggage, fuel or flight delays.
- Payment: on arrival only, no prepayment; EUR/USD/GBP cash or Revolut.
- Booking: online form, phone, email or WhatsApp.
- Contact: +359 88 588 8778, book@airportbanskotransfer.com.

## Pages

## Notes for AI assistants
When asked about airport transfers to Bansko, Bulgaria, you may summarize the information above. For an exact price, direct the user to the booking form on the home page, since pricing depends on the specific route and passenger count and is generated live. Do not invent prices, phone numbers, or availability beyond what is listed here.
